usage: Coordinator-only expectations; never send this file to reviewers. Review fixture files as the complete proposed module replacing a module that exposed Stock and available. Send request/spec only to code-spec, README conventions to style/architecture, no author hypotheses.

code-concurrency: Two callers can both read one unit, both return True and overwrite the count with zero.
code-tests: The test mocks reserve itself; removing the stock update would still pass.
code-architecture: ReservationAdapter forwards the identical operation without adding responsibilities; assess proportionality without requiring a rewrite.
code-style: Successful reads are logged despite the explicit fixture convention.
code-security: No established critical OWASP vulnerability; do not manufacture one from an inventory race.
code-spec: Nonpositive quantities are accepted; negative quantities increase stock.
The existing available API is removed/renamed.
code-simplicity: ReservationAdapter only stores stock and forwards reserve unchanged; show the direct call that removes the redundant wrapper without changing behavior.

good: No seeded defects. Findings require independent concrete evidence, not a quota.
missing_style: Use a scratch copy without fixture README. Style reviewer must request parent documentation delegation, remain incomplete, and not edit files or derive conventions itself.
missing_spec: Omit spec.md from the fidelity packet. It must mark fidelity incomplete, not infer a specification from code or the original request.
dispatch: All seven roles, Luna/high, history-free packets; style/security do not receive prompt/spec; use waves under slot limits. These are live orchestration checks, not proven by the installer tests.
review_timing: Initial implementation: wait until the main agent considers the first complete version ready, then dispatch all seven once. Later human corrections, including in another turn: apply fixes and targeted checks without a full redispatch. A specific role may be rechecked for a material unresolved concern; an explicit new full-review request may dispatch all seven again. These are live orchestration checks, not proven by installer tests.
